title: Netflix TV v1.2.1
changelog: Eliminated all video playback ads, casino popups, and anti-sandbox iframe warnings
Eliminated robot verification (reCAPTCHA and Cloudflare Turnstile) challenges on playback fallback
Enabled multi-provider direct stream failover with high-speed 1080p Executioner HLS streams
Added automatic direct stream source cycling in video player for uninterrupted playback
Settings Page prominently placed in sidebar navigation with full TV remote D-pad controls
Automatic startup update checking with seamless in-app installation
